Get an API Key First, you’ll need a valid **Google Maps Platform** API key that has the *Geocoding API* enabled. You can obtain one from the [Google Cloud Console](https://console.cloud.google.com/). > **Tip:** Keep your key secret – never expose it in client‑side JavaScript or public repositories. ### 2. Build the Request URL ```text https://maps.googleapis.com/maps/api/geocode/json?latlng=37.4224764,-122.0842499&key=YOUR_API_KEY ``` Replace `YOUR_API_KEY` with the key you obtained earlier. ### 3. Make the HTTP GET Request Below are examples in several popular languages: | Language | Example | |----------|---------| | **Python (requests)** | ```python
import requests
url = "https://maps.googleapis.com/maps/api/geocode/json"
params = {"latlng": "37.4224764,-122.0842499", "key": "YOUR_API_KEY"}
response = requests.get(url, params=params)
print(response.json())
``` | | **JavaScript (fetch)** | ```javascript
const url = new URL('https://maps.googleapis.com/maps/api/geocode/json');
url.searchParams.append('latlng', '37.4224764,-122.0842499');
url.searchParams.append('key', 'YOUR_API_KEY');
fetch(url)
.then(r => r.json())\n .then(data => console.log(data));
``` | | **cURL** | ```bash
curl "https://maps.googleapis.com/maps/api/geocode/json?latlng=37.4224764,-122.0842499&key=YOUR_API_KEY"
``` | ### 4. Interpret the Response A successful response will look like this (truncated): ```json { "results": [ { "address_components": [...], "formatted_address": "1600 Amphitheatre Parkway, Mountain View, CA 94043, USA", ... } ], "status": "OK" } ``` - `formatted_address` gives you the human‑readable address. - `geometry.location` inside each result contains the same latitude/longitude you queried, confirming the location. ### 5.
